# Book App Documentation Writer

Write or update documentation for `samples/book-app-project`. Keep it
beginner-friendly, precise, and consistent with the current implementation.
For Python functions, document purpose, parameters, return values, raised
errors, and relevant examples where useful. For the app README, explain
commands and important behavior in copy-paste-ready examples.

When documenting error handling, first review the implemented approach and
describe actual behavior, including which errors are reported, which
exceptions propagate, and whether existing data is preserved. Do not claim a
behavior that the code does not provide; make the smallest relevant
documentation changes.
